children: The annual inflation rate in the Dominican Republic eased to 5.13% in August 2026 from 5.47% in July.
The strongest price pressures were recorded in restaurants and hotels (7.96%), transport (7.36%), education (7.08%), and food and non-alcoholic beverages (5.90%).
In contrast, prices fell for clothing and footwear (-1.08%) and communications (-1.76%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.38%, accelerating from a 0.19% increase in the previous month.
Meanwhile, annual core inflation eased to 4.76% from 4.96% in July.

title: Dominican Inflation Eases in August
